## Environment

Operating system, Node version, which coding agent and version you connected, and how you started Beziera.

## Which part

MCP server · canvas · screenshot · marks · skill · CLI

## Expected behaviour

## Actual behaviour

## Reproduction

Steps from a clean design folder. If an artboard is involved, include the smallest HTML that reproduces it.

## Screenshot or artboard

Attach the rendered result if the problem is visual, and the artboard HTML if it is not.

## Sanitized evidence

Logs are welcome. Never include a real token or key, and remove anything private from artboard content before attaching it.
